name: operations.asset_trades

list.description: Read full native asset trades records.

parameters.name: to-date
parameters.description: Inclusive native trading-date end, YYYY-MM-DD; not earlier than from-date.

get.description: Read one complete native detail root; separate histories and child endpoints are unqueried.

lookup.name: orderNo
lookup.description: Native asset-transfer orderNo from the List; report/global/end-to-end references are distinct.

result_identity.description: Native returned orderNo; validated against the requested lookup without changing its type.

purpose: Inspect native operational records through bounded inquiry-only requests.

fields.name: orderNo
fields.meaning: Native nonempty row identity, retained without conversion.

fields.name: tradingDate
fields.meaning: Native trading business date retained as received; distinct from source timestamps. Native row-date format is not inferred from wire date formatting.

identity_description: Native orderNo identifies rows within the exact acquisition scope.
limitations: Ordinary List: Full native fields, types, exact decimals, nested values and unknown fields are retained. Inquiry-only List; no Get or additional history/detail requests.
Qualified width10 is based on historical successful requests, not a measured backend maximum. SDK collection owns loops, deadlines, retries, quality and cache publication.
Duplicates, count gaps and short interior pages remain incomplete. Conflicts keep the last arrival; strict refresh rejects incomplete data and preserves the prior saved capture.

Fixed tenant GUAPW3SG and timezone GMT+08; required ISO trading-date bounds map to compact native tradingDateBegin/End. Native tradingDate is retained without inferred row-date parsing or local membership filtering.

Ordinary List: Trading date is distinct from gmtCreate and actualValueDate; no source timestamp filtering or timezone conversion is inferred. Native logs already in a row are preserved; no detail enrichment.
Native root including assetProductVo and logs already returned; no separate log acquisition or asserted log ownership.
Get and supported List --live --with-detail preserve native types, nesting and unknown fields, perform no implicit history/child inquiries, and write no cache or Duckdog data.
